defs.name: Distributor
defs.text: Moves the ball into better places with passes: top 15% of {pos} for passing value per 90.

defs.name: Ball-Playing Centre Back
defs.text: Starts attacks from the back: top 15% of centre backs for passing value per 90.

defs.name: Overlapper
defs.text: A fullback who adds attacking value: top 15% of fullbacks for attack per 90.

defs.name: Ball Carrier
defs.text: Drives forward with the ball: top 15% of {pos} for carrying value per 90.

defs.name: Goal Threat
defs.text: Gets on the end of good chances, often: top 15% of {pos} for shot chance quality per 90 (expected goals, not finishing).

defs.name: Poacher
defs.text: Does a lot with few touches: top 15% of {pos} for attacking value per possession touched, while touching fewer possessions than most (bottom 40%).

defs.name: Space Finder
defs.text: Finds space to receive in dangerous places: top 15% of {pos} for receiving value per 90.

defs.name: Dead-Ball Specialist
defs.text: Creates danger from corners and free kicks: top 10% of {pos} for set-piece delivery per 90.

defs.name: Press Resistant
defs.text: Rarely gives the ball away where it hurts: top 15% of {pos} for ball security.

defs.name: No-Nonsense Centre Back
defs.text: Wins the ball outright: top 15% of centre backs for tackles, interceptions and loose-ball recoveries, by value per 90.

defs.name: Last Line
defs.text: Gets the danger out once it arrives: top 15% of centre backs for clearance value per 90.

defs.name: Ball Winner
defs.text: Takes the ball off opponents: top 15% of {pos} for tackles, interceptions and loose-ball recoveries, by value per 90.

defs.name: High Presser
defs.text: Wins the ball back in the attacking third: top 10% of {pos} for high regains per 90 (at the top 15% it repeated under 2x).

defs.name: Box-to-Box
defs.text: Adds value at both ends: top 40% of {pos} for both attack and ball-winning per 90 (the two rarely go together).

defs.name: Engine
defs.text: Always involved: top 10% of {pos} for possessions touched per 90.

defs.name: Shot-Stopper
defs.text: Saves more than the shots deserve: top 15% of keepers for goals prevented per shot faced (post-shot expected goals minus goals).

defs.name: Sweeper-Keeper
defs.text: Comes off the line to claim crosses and sweep behind the defence: top 15% of keepers for claims and sweeping per 90.

defs.name: Playmaking Keeper
defs.text: Starts attacks with the ball: top 15% of keepers for distribution value per 90.
